claims.statement: Tom Allen was announced to make his first public appearance in America since returning from England at an exhibition in the Art Gallery of Madison Square Garden, New York.
claims.excerpt: first public appearance in this country since
places: Art Gallery of Madison Square Garden, New York

claims.statement: John L. Sullivan said at the exhibition that he had not come to make a match with Tom Allen and would not be permitted to spar with him.
claims.excerpt: not come to make a match with bim, aad I will
places: Art Gallery of Madison Square Garden, New York

claims.statement: Tom Allen and George Rooke were set to wind up the exhibition with a bout that was a tame affair, and the audience hissed after the first round.
claims.excerpt: Mr. Allen and Mr. Rooke, It was a tar ae
places: Art Gallery of Madison Square Garden, New York

notes: OCR is badly garbled in the Allen and Rooke passage; the claim rests on the printed headline 'Hisses the Englishman' and the wind-up line. Allen's faint-voice remarks are paraphrased by the paper, so not quoted.
